title: Look
body:
Syntax: look  |  look <name>  |  look self  |  look me

Description: Shows the room you're in: its name, anyone/anything present, and its exits. 'look <name>' examines a player, mob, or item in the room or your own inventory instead. Looking at a player or mob now shows their visible armor, accessories, swords, wielded and off-hand weapons, and held tools without showing inventory. 'look self' or 'look me' also lists your own equipped gear.

Date: 2026-08-17
